title: Detailed teddy bear
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <circle cx='28' cy='22' r='11' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='22' r='7' fill='#D4956A'/>

  <circle cx='72' cy='22' r='11' fill='#8B5E3C'/>

  <!-- Right arm -->
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='68' rx='8' ry='12' transform='rotate(20 76 68)' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <!-- Left leg -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='94' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <!-- Right leg -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='94' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#8B5E3C'/>

  <ellipse cx='36' cy='94' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#D4956A'/>
  <!-- Right foot pad -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='94' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#D4956A'/>

  <polygon points='50,56 42,52 42,60' fill='#E04060'/>
  <polygon points='50,56 58,52 58,60' fill='#E04060'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='2.5' fill='#FF6B85'/>
